tag.description: A sha-<commit> tag of dev, as dev moves

hubName.description: Public name of the hub, with an A record to the LoadBalancer; not under rahtiapp.fi

kitsHost.description: Name of the Route for /kits, without a scheme, under rahtiapp.fi, which the router's certificate covers

flPort.description: FL port: Rahti's LoadBalancer ports are 30000 to 35000

probeResponder.description: Answer node probes on the FL port while no run is active

loadBalancerIP.description: Internal IPv4 address of the project's pool (not the public one), or empty

oidcIssuer.description: Trusted OIDC issuer, https (e.g. LS Login's); the WES refuses every run without one

oidcAlgorithms.description: Signing algorithms accepted from the issuer, comma-separated

oidcAllowedSubs.description: Subjects allowed to use the WES, comma-separated, or empty for any the issuer vouches for

tokenSecret.description: Secret with token files, mounted at /run/secrets/tes-tokens, or empty

envSecret.description: Secret whose keys become environment variables, for the secrets of oauth sources, or empty

wesRoute.description: A Route for /ga4gh/wes/v1 alone, on kitsHost

allowAnySubject.description: Allow a public WES with an empty oidcAllowedSubs, open to anyone the issuer vouches for

corsAllowedOrigins.description: Origins whose pages may call the WES API, comma-separated: scheme, host and an optional port, or empty. Stricter than WES_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS of the WES (no spaces, no trailing slash)

tesGateway.description: TES gateway (proTES) that all tasks go through, with its token from a file of tokenSecret or oauth

tokenFile.description: Key of tokenSecret with the gateway's token, or empty

oauth.description: As oauth in the sites file, with secrets from envSecret (by name, never as values), or empty
